profile.description:
Qwen3.8 Max 0902 is the upgraded September 2026 snapshot of Alibaba's flagship Qwen3.8 Max, with stronger coding, steadier multi-tool agent work, and sharper chart and document understanding. It accepts text, image, and video input with a 1M token context, and supports deep thinking, function calling, and structured JSON output.

This bot supports optional parameters for additional customization.
